chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام about a man who forgets to perform the ruku'. He said: He is to begin again, until he places everything of that in its proper place.

key_terms.مَوَاضِعَهُ: its proper places; the correct positions or sequence of the prayer's parts
key_terms.يَرْكَعَ: to perform ruku'; to bow in the prayer
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُ: he begins again or resumes from the start
key_terms.يَنْسَى: forgets; refers to omission through forgetfulness

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who forgets the ruku' in salat (prayer). Imam Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام states that he must resume properly so that each part of the prayer is restored to its correct place.
